name: RideAlligator
summary: This EA trades based on the Williams Alligator indicator, entering long positions when price is above the Alligator's lips and short positions when below, riding the trend until the Alligator lines converge signaling trend exhaustion. It uses the jaw, teeth, and lips relationship to determine trend direction and strength, opening trades when lines are properly aligned and wide apart.
summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标进行交易，当价格在鳄鱼嘴唇线上方时做多，在下方时做空，顺势持仓直至鳄鱼线收敛表示趋势耗尽。它利用颚线、齿线和唇线的关系来判断趋势方向和强度，在线条正确排列且间距较大时开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标，通过三条平滑移动平均线（颚线、齿线、唇线）的张开与收敛来判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当做多时，要求唇线在齿线上方且齿线在颚线上方，三条线呈多头排列且间距扩大，表示上涨趋势确立；做空则反之，三条线呈空头排列。出场条件主要依赖鳄鱼线的收敛，当线条开始靠拢或交叉时平仓，表示趋势可能结束。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面，该EA可能包含止损设置，但鳄鱼策略的核心理念是让利润奔跑，因此止损可能设置较宽。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，在趋势明确时获利，但在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) whose opening and closing patterns determine market trend states. Entry conditions: for long positions, the Lips must be above the Teeth and the Teeth above the Jaw, with all three lines in bullish alignment and widening gaps indicating an established uptrend; for shorts, the reverse bearish alignment is required. Exit conditions rely on Alligator line convergence, closing positions when lines begin to approach each other or cross, signaling potential trend exhaustion. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage of account equity. Money management may include stop-loss settings, but the core philosophy of the Alligator strategy is to let profits run, so stops tend to be wide. Overall, this is a classic trend-following system that profits during clear trends but can suffer consecutive losses in ranging markets.

pros: 基于经典且广受认可的趋势跟踪指标，逻辑清晰易懂
鳄鱼指标能有效识别趋势启动和结束，避免震荡市假信号
顺势持仓理念让利润充分奔跑，盈亏比潜力较高
三条线排列提供多重确认，减少虚假入场
pros_en: Based on a classic and widely recognized trend-following indicator with clear and understandable logic
The Alligator indicator effectively identifies trend initiation and termination, avoiding false signals in ranging markets
The ride-the-trend philosophy allows profits to run fully, offering high reward-to-risk potential
Triple-line alignment provides multiple confirmation layers, reducing false entries
cons: 趋势跟踪系统在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损，鳄鱼线反复交叉导致频繁开平仓
默认止损为零或设置较宽，在趋势反转时可能承受较大回撤
缺乏市场波动性过滤器，在低波动环境中信号质量下降
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场条件调整风险敞口
cons_en: As a trend-following system, it is prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets where Alligator lines repeatedly cross causing frequent open-close cycles
Default stop-loss of zero or wide settings can lead to significant drawdowns during trend reversals
Lacks a volatility filter, so signal quality degrades in low-volatility environments
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market conditions
improvements: 增加AO或AC振荡器作为辅助过滤，只在振荡器方向与鳄鱼方向一致时入场，减少震荡市虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动性自动调整风险敞口
添加新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，并加入点差过滤器保护剥头皮场景
improvements_en: Add Awesome Oscillator or Accelerator Oscillator as a supplementary filter, entering only when oscillator direction aligns with Alligator direction to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Add new bar detection to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, and include a spread filter to protect against excessive trading costs

risk_points: 默认止损为零，趋势反转时可能承受较大亏损
震荡市中鳄鱼线频繁交叉导致反复交易产生手续费损耗
缺乏新K线检测可能在同一根K线内多次开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of zero can lead to significant losses during trend reversals
Frequent Alligator line crossovers in ranging markets cause repeated trading and commission drain
Lack of new bar detection may result in multiple entries within the same bar
